bibl.title: Giuseppe Fraccaroli e Girolamo Vitelli: l'Olimpo in tumulto.
bibl.seg: Francesco Pagnotta & Rosario Pintaudi, Giuseppe Fraccaroli e Girolamo Vitelli: l'Olimpo in tumulto.
bibl.note: Complete edition of the remaining correspondence among Girolamo Vitelli and Giuseppe Fraccaroli: fourteen postcards and nine letters sent between the 20th of August 1889 and the 5th of March 1898, preserved partly in the Biblioteca Medicea Laurenziana and partly in the Biblioteca Civica di Verona. These exchanges are testimony to the optimal rapport between the two Greek scholars before the fateful year of 1899, when their differences split into two sides both Italian Classical Philology and the whole Italian culture.
